PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain: Full Integrated Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "muscle gain"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Tuesday training 30m "Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 1x20m rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 3m
        main straight_sets:
          elliptical 1x20m rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
